Class XmlClassSerializer<T>

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Serialization
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides XML serialization and deserialization for reference types using XmlSerializer.

public class XmlClassSerializer<T> where T : class

Type Parameters

T

The reference type to serialize/deserialize. Must be a class.

Remarks

This class is designed for types that are classes (reference types). It omits the XML namespace declaration and uses UTF-8 encoding without BOM. The class supports both instance and static usage for serialization and deserialization.
